title: CodeBandage — 150 platform connection methods
scope: Connection-method research for the 150 previously catalogued CMS, commerce and website-builder offerings. No connection, login, connector deployment or write operation was tested.

platforms.connection_method: API: username + Application Password. Browser: a separate WordPress user account.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; username; Application Password; requested capabilities.
platforms.limitations: Application Passwords cannot log into wp-admin. Core content endpoints do not grant arbitrary theme/server editing. WordPress.com has a separate OAuth flow.

platforms.connection_method: API: configured JSON:API/REST with session, HTTPS Basic, or an OAuth module. Browser: a role-based Drupal account.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; version; enabled API/auth modules; user or OAuth app credentials.
platforms.limitations: JSON:API writes and permissions must be enabled; Simple OAuth is an added module, not a universal built-in key.

platforms.connection_method: API: Joomla API token (X-Joomla-Token), with required plugins and permissions. Browser: backend user.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; Joomla version; token; required resources.
platforms.limitations: Do not grant Super User solely for convenience. Token features depend on installed version and enabled plugins.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: TYPO3 backend account. API: a configured REST extension/custom connector—not a universal core API key.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; version; extension inventory; backend role or configured API credentials.
platforms.limitations: Review extension compatibility and permissions; do not label an extension's auth as TYPO3 core functionality.

platforms.connection_method: API: Ghost Admin API integration key → signed JWT. Browser: invited staff account.
platforms.required_information: Admin API URL; integration key; API version; permitted operation.
platforms.limitations: Content API keys are read-only; they are not Admin API keys or staff login credentials.

platforms.connection_method: API: private-schema GraphQL bearer token, with configured mutations. Browser: Craft control-panel account.
platforms.required_information: Site GraphQL endpoint; version/edition; scoped token; schema permissions.
platforms.limitations: Check edition, version and mutation support. A content token is not arbitrary filesystem access.

platforms.connection_method: API: read-only REST token, when enabled. Writes: Statamic control-panel user, Git, or a reviewed custom API.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; version; token if enabled; content/Git access for writes.
platforms.limitations: The documented REST delivery API is read-only; do not advertise it as a repair/write connector.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: ProcessWire user with roles. Remote automation: custom REST/module; PHP API is not remote authentication.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native remote management authentication was not verified. Source/code changes need separately authorized repository or hosting access.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: MODX Manager user with ACLs. Remote management API: custom integration; verify the installed setup.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native remote management authentication was not verified. Source/code changes need separately authorized repository or hosting access.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: ExpressionEngine control-panel member with permissions. Remote automation: reviewed add-on/custom API.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native remote management authentication was not verified. Source/code changes need separately authorized repository or hosting access.

platforms.connection_method: API: configured Concrete CMS REST integration using OAuth/JWT and scopes. Browser: Dashboard account.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; CMS version; enabled REST API; integration credentials and scopes.
platforms.limitations: Verify the installed version and enabled API; do not assume all older installations expose the same endpoints.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: October CMS backend user. API: installed plugin or custom REST authentication.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native remote management authentication was not verified. Source/code changes need separately authorized repository or hosting access.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: Winter CMS backend user. API: reviewed plugin/custom connector.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native remote management authentication was not verified. Source/code changes need separately authorized repository or hosting access.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: Grav Admin-plugin user. Files/code: separately approved Git/SFTP access; custom API if needed.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native remote management authentication was not verified. Source/code changes need separately authorized repository or hosting access.

platforms.connection_method: API: Kirby session authentication, or HTTPS Basic when enabled. Browser: Panel user.
platforms.required_information: Site API URL; user; installed version; enabled authentication method.
platforms.limitations: User permissions still apply. Do not enable broad Basic access without reviewing HTTPS and intended use.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: Silverstripe CMS user. API: configured GraphQL authentication; module/version dependent.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; framework/module versions; enabled endpoint and auth configuration.
platforms.limitations: The cited GraphQL guidance is version-specific. Verify the deployed API; no universal CMS API key is assumed.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: Contao backend user/group. Remote API access requires a reviewed extension/custom connector.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native remote management authentication was not verified. Source/code changes need separately authorized repository or hosting access.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: owner-authorized CMS Made Simple administration. Native remote write API/authentication: not verified.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Project source was located, but current remote-auth and delegation details were not verified. Do not treat this as an API-ready connector.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: Textpattern user with Designer/Editor or other appropriate privileges. Remote API: custom connector.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native remote management authentication was not verified. Source/code changes need separately authorized repository or hosting access.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: Backdrop user/role. API: reviewed Services/headless module or custom endpoint, where installed.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; Backdrop version; installed module/version; role and configured credentials.
platforms.limitations: Review module release maturity and write support; a headless read endpoint is not a general repair API.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: Wagtail admin user. API v2 is read-only; v3 preview supports scoped user bearer tokens.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; Wagtail version; API version; user token where supported.
platforms.limitations: v3 documentation marks this as preview. Verify production suitability; do not promise v3 on an older site.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: django CMS/Django user and page permissions. API: custom Django REST/GraphQL authentication.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native remote management authentication was not verified. Source/code changes need separately authorized repository or hosting access.

platforms.connection_method: API: plone.restapi JWT/login or HTTPS Basic. Browser: Plone/Volto user with roles.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; API availability; user/token; required roles.
platforms.limitations: Token permissions follow the user. Content API access does not automatically grant deployment privileges.

platforms.connection_method: API: configured Orchard Core OpenID/OAuth client with scopes. Browser: admin user/role.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; enabled modules; client ID/secret or approved user flow; scopes.
platforms.limitations: OpenID/API modules must be configured; do not assume every Orchard installation has the same remote API.

platforms.connection_method: API: Umbraco Management API API-user client ID + secret on supported versions. Browser: separate Backoffice user.
platforms.required_information: CMS URL/version; API-user client credentials; required permissions.
platforms.limitations: API users arrived in Umbraco 15; verify installed version and API permissions.

platforms.connection_method: API: configured DNN JWT authentication handler. Browser: portal user with authorized roles.
platforms.required_information: Portal URL/version; enabled authentication handler; permitted user/token.
platforms.limitations: Handler configuration and installed API endpoints determine available operations.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: OpenCms Workplace account or configured SSO. Remote management: custom/version-specific integration.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native remote management authentication was not verified. Source/code changes need separately authorized repository or hosting access.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: Sulu admin user. API: the deployment's configured Symfony security/authentication.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; version; security firewall configuration; assigned permissions.
platforms.limitations: Confirm the actual endpoint, authentication and content-write permissions before implementing a connector.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: Neos backend account with roles. Remote management: reviewed custom REST/GraphQL connector.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native remote management authentication was not verified. Source/code changes need separately authorized repository or hosting access.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: REDAXO backend user/role. API: separately reviewed add-on/custom integration.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native remote management authentication was not verified. Source/code changes need separately authorized repository or hosting access.

platforms.connection_method: API: Bludit API-plugin token; writes additionally require a user authentication token. Browser: dashboard user.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; API-plugin setting; API token; user authentication token for writes.
platforms.limitations: An API token alone does not authorize every write. Verify plugin/version and user privileges.

platforms.connection_method: Desktop: Publii project access. Publishing: SFTP/FTPS, Git, or supported storage credentials—not a browser CMS login.
platforms.required_information: Project files; publishing method; host/repository/bucket; scoped deploy credential.
platforms.limitations: Directly editing generated files can be overwritten by the next publish. Publii does not provide a conventional browser CMS account.

platforms.connection_method: API: per-user enabled HTTPS Basic access. Browser: Typemill editor; verify write endpoints separately.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; user; API-enabled setting; endpoint requirements.
platforms.limitations: API documentation is content/read focused; do not assume unrestricted management or write coverage.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: Automad Dashboard user. Files/code: approved repository/hosting access; remote management API unverified.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native remote management authentication was not verified. Source/code changes need separately authorized repository or hosting access.

platforms.connection_method: API: version-supported ClassicPress Application Password + username. Browser: a separate CMS account.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; ClassicPress version; username; Application Password.
platforms.limitations: Verify the installed version. Application Passwords are API credentials, not interactive login passwords.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: SPIP private-area author/editor account. Remote API: reviewed plugin/custom connector.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native remote management authentication was not verified. Source/code changes need separately authorized repository or hosting access.

platforms.connection_method: API: Movable Type Data API username + web-services password + client ID → access token. Browser: normal user.
platforms.required_information: Data API URL/version; username; web-services password; client ID.
platforms.limitations: The web-services password is distinct from ordinary browser credentials; permissions and API version still matter.

platforms.connection_method: API: a-blog cms module JSON API key (X-API-KEY), read-oriented. Writes: authorized CMS editor.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; module/API settings; API key; browser role for editing.
platforms.limitations: The documented module-data API is not evidence of a universal remote-write API.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: owner-assisted WonderCMS administrator login. No verified native remote-write API or separate collaborator role.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Avoid sharing the primary owner's password. Use owner-assisted changes or a separately authorized file workflow; native remote-write authentication was not verified.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: HTMLy admin/editor/author account. Source changes: approved file/repository access; remote-write API unverified.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native remote management authentication was not verified. Source/code changes need separately authorized repository or hosting access.

platforms.connection_method: API: scoped Strapi API token for REST/GraphQL. Browser: invited admin user; admin credentials are separate.
platforms.required_information: Instance URL; token; content-type permissions; version.
platforms.limitations: A content token is not blanket admin or source-code access.

platforms.connection_method: API: Directus static user token or JWT/refresh token. Browser: Data Studio user with policies.
platforms.required_information: Instance URL; user/service token; roles/policies.
platforms.limitations: Do not use an unrestricted administrator token as the default connector.

platforms.connection_method: API: Payload collection API key or JWT, with configured access rules. Browser: auth-collection admin account.
platforms.required_information: Instance URL; auth-collection slug; API key/JWT; access configuration.
platforms.limitations: API-key authentication must be enabled; permissions are code-defined.

platforms.connection_method: API: Contentful Management API personal token or OAuth. Browser: space/organization invitation.
platforms.required_information: Space ID; environment ID; CMA token/OAuth grant; role.
platforms.limitations: Delivery/Preview tokens do not grant management writes. Review environment and role restrictions.

platforms.connection_method: API: Sanity project/robot token with write role. Browser: project member using Studio.
platforms.required_information: Project ID; dataset; token; API version; role.
platforms.limitations: Public/read tokens are not write credentials; source changes to Studio require repository access.

platforms.connection_method: API: Storyblok Management personal token or OAuth. Browser: invited space user.
platforms.required_information: Space ID; region; management token/OAuth grant.
platforms.limitations: Delivery access tokens cannot substitute for Management API authorization.

platforms.connection_method: API: Prismic Migration API write token for supported imports/updates. Browser: repository editor.
platforms.required_information: Repository name; Migration API token; target documents/release.
platforms.limitations: Read API tokens are not write tokens. Migration endpoints are not a universal theme/code editor.

platforms.connection_method: API: Contentstack stack API key + scoped Management token. Browser: stack user/role.
platforms.required_information: Stack API key; Management token; region; target environment.
platforms.limitations: Delivery tokens are read-only and separate from Management tokens.

platforms.connection_method: API: Hygraph permanent auth token with environment/write permissions. Browser: project member.
platforms.required_information: Project endpoint; environment; token; permissions.
platforms.limitations: Public/read permissions do not authorize mutations or schema management automatically.

platforms.connection_method: API: DatoCMS scoped Content Management API token. Browser: project member.
platforms.required_information: Project/environment; token; role; target records.
platforms.limitations: Delivery API credentials/permissions do not imply management or deployment authority.

platforms.connection_method: API: Kontent.ai environment Management API key, sent as bearer token. Browser: project/environment user.
platforms.required_information: Environment ID; Management API key; permitted content actions.
platforms.limitations: Delivery, Preview and Management credentials serve different purposes.

platforms.connection_method: API: ButterCMS Write API token; write access is an add-on. Browser: team account.
platforms.required_information: Write API token; account entitlement; target content.
platforms.limitations: Read token cannot write. Verify Write API add-on and endpoint coverage before promising automation.

platforms.connection_method: API: Cosmic bucket slug + write key. Browser: bucket/project team member.
platforms.required_information: Bucket slug; write key; permissions.
platforms.limitations: Protect the write key server-side; read keys do not permit content modifications.

platforms.connection_method: API: Agility CMS Management OAuth access/refresh tokens. Browser: instance user; verify beta-token eligibility.
platforms.required_information: Instance GUID; region; OAuth app credentials/grant; permitted operations.
platforms.limitations: Personal access tokens are documented as public beta; do not assume production availability or suitability.

platforms.connection_method: API: Squidex app client ID + secret → OAuth bearer token. Browser: app collaborator.
platforms.required_information: App name; client ID; client secret; role.
platforms.limitations: Client permissions and content workflow constrain writes and publication.

platforms.connection_method: API: configured ApostropheCMS API key/bearer authentication. Browser: editor account.
platforms.required_information: Instance URL; configured API credential; role; API version.
platforms.limitations: Review custom project code and API configuration; do not assume every site exposes identical operations.

platforms.connection_method: API: Keystone's configured GraphQL authentication/session. Browser: Admin UI account.
platforms.required_information: GraphQL endpoint; auth-list configuration; account/session or custom service credential.
platforms.limitations: There is no universal preconfigured Keystone API key. Access is defined by application code.

platforms.connection_method: Read API: TinaCMS client ID + branch + content token. Editing: authorized Tina editor/Git access.
platforms.required_information: Client ID; branch; content token for reads; editor/repository authorization for writes.
platforms.limitations: A read-only content token must not be treated as a write token or general repository credential.

platforms.connection_method: Editing: Decap CMS Git-provider OAuth/backend authorization. Content changes become repository commits.
platforms.required_information: Backend/provider; repository; branch; OAuth application/approved grant.
platforms.limitations: Use narrow repository permissions. Decap authorization does not grant hosting-server access.

platforms.connection_method: API: CloudCannon API key for supported platform actions. Content/code: authorized editor and connected Git repository.
platforms.required_information: Organization/site IDs; API key; repository permissions where required.
platforms.limitations: Confirm endpoint write support; platform API access and source-file editing are different capabilities.

platforms.connection_method: API: Builder.io private Write API key or scoped token. Browser: space/team member.
platforms.required_information: Space; private credential; models; role/scopes.
platforms.limitations: Public content API keys are not write authorization; distinguish Publish from other Builder products.

platforms.connection_method: API: Webiny scoped Headless CMS API key. Browser: authorized Webiny identity-provider user.
platforms.required_information: Deployment endpoint; environment; tenant/locale; API key/permissions.
platforms.limitations: The self-hosted deployment's configuration controls identity, scope and publishing rights.

platforms.connection_method: API: Cockpit API key with assigned permissions. Browser: named dashboard user.
platforms.required_information: Cockpit URL/version; API key; resource permissions.
platforms.limitations: Use the installed version's auth convention; do not expose a broad admin key.

platforms.connection_method: API/CLI: Crafter Studio Management API token. Browser: Studio user with site permissions.
platforms.required_information: Studio URL; site ID; access token; role.
platforms.limitations: Engine/delivery access is not Studio management access; repository and deployment permissions remain separate.

platforms.connection_method: API: configured Enonic management service credentials/JWT. Browser: Content Studio user.
platforms.required_information: XP URL/version; management API configuration; service identity; scopes.
platforms.limitations: Management endpoints are not a universal content CRUD token; application content APIs may be custom.

platforms.connection_method: API: Flotiq X-AUTH-TOKEN with read/write permissions. Browser: project user.
platforms.required_information: API token; target content types; permissions.
platforms.limitations: Read-only credentials cannot perform writes; inspect the actual account's permissions.

platforms.connection_method: API: Prepr Mutation API bearer token. Browser: authorized environment editor.
platforms.required_information: Environment endpoint; mutation token; required permissions.
platforms.limitations: GraphQL delivery access is separate from mutation/write authorization.

platforms.connection_method: API: Caisy personal access token for its internal/write API. Browser: project member.
platforms.required_information: Project/environment; PAT; permissions.
platforms.limitations: External content-delivery access is not write access. Review PAT breadth.

platforms.connection_method: API: BCMS API key ID + secret with instance permissions. Browser: instance/team user.
platforms.required_information: Instance ID; key ID; key secret; access permissions.
platforms.limitations: Enable only necessary read/write permissions and confirm SDK/API version.

platforms.connection_method: Editing: Keystatic GitHub App/OAuth repository access; local mode uses authorized filesystem access.
platforms.required_information: GitHub app installation; repository; branch; approved editor permissions.
platforms.limitations: No universal hosted-CMS API key; protect branches and separate deployment authorization.

platforms.connection_method: AEM Cloud API: Adobe OAuth server-to-server credentials + product profiles. Browser: authorized Adobe author account.
platforms.required_information: Organization; project/client ID; client secret; scopes; AEM endpoint.
platforms.limitations: AEM 6.5/self-managed deployments differ. Do not use retired service-account JWT instructions for new Cloud integrations.

platforms.connection_method: Sitecore XM Cloud: automation client credentials → token. Browser: Portal/author account; XP/XM setup differs.
platforms.required_information: Exact product; environment/site; client credentials; scopes/roles.
platforms.limitations: Sitecore is a product family. Verify XP/XM/XM Cloud and the exact authoring API rather than assuming one universal key.

platforms.connection_method: Optimizely CMS SaaS: OAuth API client ID + secret. Browser: CMS user; CMS 12 authentication is deployment-specific.
platforms.required_information: Edition/version; endpoint; OAuth client; scopes.
platforms.limitations: Verify SaaS versus CMS 12/PaaS APIs; delivery access is not unrestricted authoring access.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: Xperience by Kentico admin user. Custom production integration; Management MCP is development-scoped.
platforms.required_information: Version; site; roles; reviewed integration or repository access.
platforms.limitations: Do not expose the local Management MCP development server as a production management service.

platforms.connection_method: API: Sitefinity OAuth2; access keys where the authentication protocol supports them. Browser: backend user.
platforms.required_information: Version; authentication protocol; endpoint; OAuth/access-key configuration.
platforms.limitations: OpenID and Default authentication do not expose identical credential options.

platforms.connection_method: API: Magnolia configured HTTPS Basic/service user or other enabled authentication. Browser: authoring user.
platforms.required_information: Version; author endpoint; enabled REST/login handlers; technical user; ACLs.
platforms.limitations: Check service definitions and ACLs. Development MCP tools are not automatically production-approved APIs.

platforms.connection_method: API: Bloomreach Content Management API token (x-auth-token). Browser: authorized content user.
platforms.required_information: Environment; management endpoint; token; role.
platforms.limitations: Content-delivery credentials cannot substitute for management access.

platforms.connection_method: API: provisioned CoreMedia Cloud Ingest JWT for supported imports. Browser: Studio user/SSO.
platforms.required_information: Edition/service; endpoint; provisioned JWT; permitted ingestion scope.
platforms.limitations: Ingest authorization is not complete Studio management or deployment access. Other APIs require separate review.

platforms.connection_method: API: Jahia Personal API Token module with scopes. Browser: Jahia user/role.
platforms.required_information: Jahia version; token module; token/scopes; target site.
platforms.limitations: Module availability and configured permissions determine API access.

platforms.connection_method: API: Liferay OAuth2 application with scoped bearer token. Browser: portal/content user.
platforms.required_information: Portal URL; OAuth app credentials/grant; scopes.
platforms.limitations: API scopes and user/application roles both matter.

platforms.connection_method: API: dotCMS user/API JWT with role and expiry restrictions. Browser: backend user.
platforms.required_information: Instance URL; API token; user role; expiry.
platforms.limitations: Token authorization follows user permissions; avoid global admin defaults.

platforms.connection_method: API: Squiz Matrix Asset Management API bearer token, when enabled. Browser: Matrix editor.
platforms.required_information: Matrix version; feature availability; endpoint; token; asset permissions.
platforms.limitations: Read-only content APIs are not Asset Management API writes; confirm feature licensing/configuration.

platforms.connection_method: API: Brightspot REST Management client ID + client secret. Browser: CMS editorial account.
platforms.required_information: Instance URL; API client ID; client secret; scopes/permissions.
platforms.limitations: Verify installed modules/endpoints and client permissions.

platforms.connection_method: API: Terminalfour user web-services API token on supported versions. Browser: named editor.
platforms.required_information: Server URL; version; API token; user permissions.
platforms.limitations: Verify version and enabled services; API-token support is version-specific.

platforms.connection_method: API: Cascade CMS user API key for REST/SOAP. Browser: Cascade account with site permissions.
platforms.required_information: Instance URL; API key; user/site permissions.
platforms.limitations: Key inherits user authorization; it is not a browser session or server credential.

platforms.connection_method: API: merchant-approved Shopify OAuth → Admin API token; API key alone is insufficient. Browser: collaborator/staff invitation.
platforms.required_information: Shop's myshopify.com domain; installed app/client ID; secret handled server-side; approved OAuth grant/scopes.
platforms.limitations: An API key/client ID is not an Admin API token. Storefront tokens are not Admin tokens. Theme/app/checkout access has distinct restrictions.

platforms.connection_method: API: WooCommerce Consumer Key + Consumer Secret with scoped user permissions. Browser: WordPress Shop Manager/custom role.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; consumer key; consumer secret; read/write scope.
platforms.limitations: Commerce API permissions do not grant full WordPress theme/plugin/server editing.

platforms.connection_method: Magento/Open Source/PaaS: integration OAuth credentials. Adobe Commerce SaaS: Adobe IMS OAuth. Browser: scoped admin.
platforms.required_information: Exact edition/version; endpoint; OAuth integration or IMS application; permissions.
platforms.limitations: Standalone integration bearer-token use may be disabled by default. Do not use shopper credentials for admin operations.

platforms.connection_method: API: BigCommerce installed-app OAuth or store API account access token + store hash. Browser: store user.
platforms.required_information: Store hash; access token/OAuth grant; approved scopes.
platforms.limitations: A storefront token is not an Admin management credential.

platforms.connection_method: API: PrestaShop Webservice key with resource/method permissions. Browser: employee profile; newer Admin API differs.
platforms.required_information: Shop URL; version; webservice key; allowed resources/methods.
platforms.limitations: Do not assume all API versions share a credential flow. Theme/source access is separate.

platforms.connection_method: API: OpenCart API user/key + allowed caller IP → token. Browser: admin user with permissions.
platforms.required_information: Store URL/version; API key/user; allowed egress IP.
platforms.limitations: Built-in API scope is limited and version-specific; it is not a universal admin/page-builder API.

platforms.connection_method: API: Shopware Admin API integration access-key ID + secret → OAuth token. Browser: administration user.
platforms.required_information: Shop URL; integration access-key ID; secret; privileges.
platforms.limitations: Store API access keys are not Admin API credentials.

platforms.connection_method: API: Ecwid store ID + secret app token, or merchant OAuth for multi-store apps. Browser: eligible staff access.
platforms.required_information: Store ID; installed app/token or OAuth grant; scopes.
platforms.limitations: Verify plan and app eligibility; a public storefront token does not grant privileged writes.

platforms.connection_method: API: Shift4Shop SecureURL + app PrivateKey + merchant Token. Browser: staff account.
platforms.required_information: Store SecureURL; app private key; merchant token; API version.
platforms.limitations: API credentials are not the owner's browser password. Confirm the current partner/install flow.

platforms.connection_method: API: CS-Cart administrator email + API key over HTTPS Basic. Browser: permission-limited administrator.
platforms.required_information: Store URL; admin email; API key; permitted operations.
platforms.limitations: Use only the intended store/vendor scope; do not use broad administrator privileges unnecessarily.

platforms.connection_method: API: X-Cart 5.5/5.6 Admin API X-AUTH-TOKEN with appropriate read/write rights. Browser: admin account.
platforms.required_information: Store URL; exact version; Admin API token; read/write permissions.
platforms.limitations: Earlier X-Cart editions differ; verify API version rather than applying this universally.

platforms.connection_method: API: nopCommerce Web API plugin Backend authentication → JWT. Browser: ACL-limited administrator.
platforms.required_information: Shop URL/version; installed API plugin/license; dedicated account and token.
platforms.limitations: Plugin installation/licensing is required; Storefront tokens and JWT signing keys are not admin-client credentials.

platforms.connection_method: API: Sylius configured Admin API authentication; verify the version's token flow. Browser: administrator.
platforms.required_information: Shop URL; version; enabled Admin API; account/auth settings.
platforms.limitations: Authentication details need deployment-specific confirmation; do not substitute Shop API credentials.

platforms.connection_method: API: Bagisto installed API package's Admin integration token. Browser: admin user; older API packages differ.
platforms.required_information: Version; installed API package; endpoint; Admin integration token.
platforms.limitations: Storefront/public API keys are not Admin tokens. Confirm package/version before implementation.

platforms.connection_method: API: current Spree Admin secret API key; older versions may use OAuth. Browser: staff account.
platforms.required_information: Spree version; endpoint; secret API key; permissions.
platforms.limitations: Publishable Store API keys are not Admin secret keys.

platforms.connection_method: API: Solidus user API key; bearer authentication for its GraphQL extension. Browser: backend user.
platforms.required_information: Solidus/API extension version; endpoint; user API key; role.
platforms.limitations: Confirm installed REST/GraphQL API and permission checks; do not assume one header across all versions.

platforms.connection_method: API: Saleor installed-app token with permissions. Browser: Dashboard staff invitation.
platforms.required_information: GraphQL endpoint; installed app token; permissions/channel scope.
platforms.limitations: Shopper tokens do not grant staff/app management rights.

platforms.connection_method: API: Medusa secret API key via HTTP Basic, or Admin JWT. Browser: Admin user.
platforms.required_information: Backend URL; secret API key or admin authentication; version.
platforms.limitations: Publishable API keys are for Store API access, not unrestricted administration.

platforms.connection_method: API: Vendure Admin GraphQL login → bearer token/session. Browser: Dashboard administrator.
platforms.required_information: Admin API URL; approved identity; auth strategy; channel if applicable.
platforms.limitations: A channel token identifies context; it is not administrator authentication.

platforms.connection_method: API: Odoo 19 JSON-2 user API key/bearer; older versions use RPC. Browser: internal user with permissions.
platforms.required_information: Database/instance; version; API key; user rights; plan eligibility.
platforms.limitations: Odoo Online external API access requires an eligible Custom plan. APIs do not bypass model record rules.

platforms.connection_method: B2C Commerce API: Account Manager OAuth client + Admin scopes. Browser: Business Manager user; other editions differ.
platforms.required_information: Product edition; organization/instance; client ID/secret; Admin scopes.
platforms.limitations: Shopper SLAS tokens do not provide Admin rights. B2B/other Commerce offerings require separate mapping.

platforms.connection_method: API: SAP Commerce inbound Integration API OAuth/service identity. Browser: Backoffice user.
platforms.required_information: Environment; client credentials; integration user/object permissions.
platforms.limitations: OCC shopper authentication is not Backoffice/inbound administration access.

platforms.connection_method: API: commercetools project key + OAuth client ID/secret and scopes. Browser: Merchant Center team user.
platforms.required_information: Region; project key; client ID; client secret; scopes.
platforms.limitations: Create a narrow service client; avoid manage_project when smaller scopes suffice.

platforms.connection_method: API: configured Spryker Backend/Glue authentication. Browser: Backoffice user; verify enabled OAuth integration.
platforms.required_information: Deployment/version; enabled backend APIs; auth configuration; service identity.
platforms.limitations: Authentication is solution-specific. Storefront access is not backend administration.

platforms.connection_method: API: VTEX AppKey + AppToken with License Manager roles. Browser: invited VTEX account user.
platforms.required_information: Account name; workspace where relevant; AppKey; AppToken; roles.
platforms.limitations: Keys are API credentials, not ordinary browser logins; separate IO/deployment permissions as needed.

platforms.connection_method: API: Shoplazza merchant-installed app OAuth access token. Browser: authorized staff/Partner account.
platforms.required_information: Store domain/ID; app OAuth client; approved token; scopes.
platforms.limitations: Use the supported app type and current API version. Source/theme CLI access requires its own approved flow.

platforms.connection_method: API: SHOPLINE app OAuth or eligible private-app Admin token. Browser: staff account.
platforms.required_information: Exact SHOPLINE product/region; store domain; app credentials/grant; scopes.
platforms.limitations: Storefront tokens are not Admin authorization; regional product/API differences require verification.

platforms.connection_method: API: ShopBase OAuth app, or private-app API key + API password. Browser: authorized staff.
platforms.required_information: Store domain; app credentials or private-app key/password; scopes.
platforms.limitations: The API password is not the owner's account password. Verify app type and endpoint permissions.

platforms.connection_method: API: Big Cartel OAuth2 app authorization. Browser: owner-assisted administration unless delegated access is confirmed.
platforms.required_information: Store/account context; registered app credentials; OAuth grant/scopes.
platforms.limitations: Verify app eligibility and API coverage; do not assume a multi-user editor or full template API.

platforms.connection_method: API: Square seller OAuth; personal token only for the account owner's use. Browser: permitted Square team access.
platforms.required_information: Application ID; seller grant/token; scopes; location IDs as needed.
platforms.limitations: Catalog/order/payment APIs do not imply unrestricted Square Online layout editing. Personal tokens are not a multi-merchant OAuth substitute.

platforms.connection_method: API: Salla merchant app OAuth access token and scopes. Browser: approved merchant staff access.
platforms.required_information: App registration; merchant grant; access/refresh tokens; scopes.
platforms.limitations: Confirm app approval and staff permissions; no direct SaaS server access is granted.

platforms.connection_method: API: Zid merchant OAuth plus required manager/store credentials. Browser: merchant staff account.
platforms.required_information: App credentials/grant; store context; authorization and manager tokens as required by the API version.
platforms.limitations: Do not treat one generic API key as sufficient for all Zid Manager API calls.

platforms.connection_method: API: Nuvemshop/Tiendanube installed-app OAuth token + store ID. Browser: store user.
platforms.required_information: Store ID; app credentials; merchant grant/token; scopes.
platforms.limitations: Use the correct regional platform and API header convention; avoid conflating storefront and admin access.

platforms.connection_method: API: Tray partner application credentials + merchant installation code → store access/refresh tokens. Browser: staff user.
platforms.required_information: Store/API URL; app consumer key/secret; installation authorization code; tokens.
platforms.limitations: This is Tray e-commerce, not Tray.ai. Verify app/partner eligibility.

platforms.connection_method: API: Loja Integrada Personal Token, or approved partner application/store keys. Browser: authorized store account.
platforms.required_information: Store; eligible plan; Personal Token or partner application/store credentials.
platforms.limitations: Credential issuance and paid-plan restrictions changed; do not assume legacy self-service application keys remain available.

platforms.connection_method: API: EKM partner application OAuth2 access token. Browser: permitted store user.
platforms.required_information: Registered app/client credentials; merchant grant/token; endpoint scopes.
platforms.limitations: Confirm partner access and endpoint coverage; browser permissions are a separate approval.

platforms.connection_method: API: Jumpseller Login Key + Auth Token, or partner OAuth. Browser: store user with permissions.
platforms.required_information: Store context; Login Key; Auth Token or OAuth app grant.
platforms.limitations: MCP is another tool interface, not a way to bypass merchant permissions.

platforms.connection_method: API: IdoSell Admin API key or OAuth2 with method permissions. Browser: panel user.
platforms.required_information: Shop/panel domain; Admin key or OAuth credentials; permitted methods.
platforms.limitations: Keep access limited to the required shop/API methods.

platforms.connection_method: API: Shoptet add-on OAuth → short-lived API token; Premium private API token where eligible. Browser: staff user.
platforms.required_information: Shop ID; approved add-on/client; grant/token; endpoint groups; Premium eligibility if used.
platforms.limitations: Private API is not available to every plan; verify access groups and token lifetimes.

platforms.connection_method: API: ePages OAuth2 token + shop ID and scopes. Browser: store administration account.
platforms.required_information: Provider/edition; API base URL; shop ID; OAuth grant and scopes.
platforms.limitations: API and app availability depend on the hosted provider/product edition.

platforms.connection_method: API: Wix third-party app OAuth; account API key only for eligible own-account use. Browser: invited collaborator.
platforms.required_information: App/client; OAuth grant; site/account ID; scopes. For own-account use: eligible API key.
platforms.limitations: A developer's account API key is not a substitute for customer-approved app OAuth. APIs do not expose every visual-editor capability.

platforms.connection_method: API: Squarespace Commerce API key or OAuth. Browser: invited website contributor for content/design changes.
platforms.required_information: Website/store context; eligible API key/OAuth grant; commerce scopes.
platforms.limitations: Commerce access is not a universal page-layout/theme editing API; check plan and contributor permissions.

platforms.connection_method: API: Webflow site token or OAuth app with scopes. Browser: site/workspace guest or member.
platforms.required_information: Site ID; OAuth grant or site token; scopes; workspace permissions if needed.
platforms.limitations: Data API, Designer extensions and custom-code permissions differ; some functionality needs OAuth/app eligibility.

platforms.connection_method: API: Framer project Server API key. Browser: project editor invitation; verify available API operations.
platforms.required_information: Project/site context; Server API key; eligible features and permissions.
platforms.limitations: Server API is distinct from browser/editor login; verify current feature availability and publishing permissions.

platforms.connection_method: API: Duda dedicated API username/password; app token where required. Browser: team/client user.
platforms.required_information: API username; API password; site name/ID; app token where required; plan entitlement.
platforms.limitations: These are dedicated API credentials, not the owner's browser password. Verify API-plan and app requirements.

platforms.connection_method: API: HubSpot app OAuth or scoped private-app token. Browser: CRM/CMS user with content permissions.
platforms.required_information: Account/hub ID; OAuth grant/private token; content scopes.
platforms.limitations: Do not use retired legacy hapikey authentication. New/beta credential options require separate review.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: GoDaddy delegate/team-member access to Websites + Marketing. Domain/DNS API keys are not website-editor access.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native general Website Builder authoring API authentication was not verified. GoDaddy domain/DNS API access does not edit website content.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: Hostinger hPanel Account Sharing for supported sites/services. Builder e-commerce sharing has restrictions.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: The cited sharing guide excludes Builder e-commerce delegation. VPS/API/FTP permissions do not establish access to the hosted Website Builder editor.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: IONOS Agency Partner delegation or owner-assisted MyWebsite editor. Confirm product coverage.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Partner access can be broader than site editing. Confirm exact MyWebsite product and use the smallest available grant. DNS/Cloud APIs are not builder authoring APIs.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: owner-assisted Jimdo editing; confirm Creator versus Website Builder. Native write API not verified.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: The vendor's shared-account guidance is not an independent collaborator security boundary. Do not share the owner's primary password; review the exact product.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: Webnode project invitation with Editor/Admin permissions. Native management API not verified.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native remote management authentication was not verified. Source/code changes need separately authorized repository or hosting access.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: Strikingly site Team/teammate invitation. Native remote authoring API not verified.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native remote management authentication was not verified. Source/code changes need separately authorized repository or hosting access.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: SITE123 contributor invitation with selected modules/permissions. Native management API not verified.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native remote management authentication was not verified. Source/code changes need separately authorized repository or hosting access.

platforms.connection_method: API: Tilda Public Key + Secret Key for export/read operations. Writes: owner-authorized browser editor.
platforms.required_information: Project/page IDs; Business entitlement; public/secret API keys; browser editor grant for writes.
platforms.limitations: Export API is not a remote page/block write API. Avoid logging URLs containing secret API parameters.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: Carrd site-sharing invitation as Editor/Admin on eligible Pro plans. Native authoring API not verified.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Plan restrictions apply. Exported-site hosting does not imply changes sync back into the Carrd editor.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: owner-assisted Yola editing. Official guidance does not provide independent role-based collaborator accounts.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Separate users/role-based collaborator access are not provided by the cited guidance. Native management API authentication was not verified.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: Weblium contributor invitation with limited site-editing access. Native management API not verified.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Contributor permissions exclude some account/domain/backup operations; verify publishing and custom-code rights separately.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: Ucraft Team App invitation with Editor/Designer permissions on eligible plans. Native management API unverified.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Check paid-plan and product-generation compatibility; Ucraft offerings do not all have identical team/API features.

platforms.connection_method: API: Dorik Public API key for documented endpoints, including eligible SEO updates. Browser: Developer/Editor invitation.
platforms.required_information: Site/collection identifiers; API key; entitlement; selected operation.
platforms.limitations: Do not infer full page-builder CRUD from limited content/SEO API documentation; verify endpoint and current API maturity.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: Pixpa contributor/user-permissions invitation. Native remote authoring API not verified.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Native remote management authentication was not verified. Source/code changes need separately authorized repository or hosting access.

platforms.connection_method: API: SmugMug OAuth 1.0a app credentials + user token/secret. Browser: owner-approved editor access.
platforms.required_information: Registered app consumer key/secret; user OAuth grant/token secret; permissions.
platforms.limitations: Photo/gallery API access is not blanket site-layout editing. Do not substitute exported browser cookies.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: owner-assisted Format website editing. Native write API and independent developer-role access not verified.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Official support source identifies the account/editor help route, not a verified API authentication or multi-user delegation method.

platforms.connection_method: Legacy/Classic Zenfolio API: vendor authentication → session token. Browser: owner-authorized editor; confirm product generation.
platforms.required_information: Exact Zenfolio product; registered API integration if required; supported authentication/token.
platforms.limitations: Legacy API documentation is not proof that new Zenfolio accounts support it. Keep account credentials out of models/logs; API is limited to documented operations.

platforms.connection_method: API: Simvoly website API bearer key for supported store/contact/member operations. Browser: authorized site editor.
platforms.required_information: Website ID/context; API key; permitted endpoints.
platforms.limitations: Store/contact/member API is not unrestricted visual-canvas editing. Member SSO endpoints are not administrator login.

platforms.connection_method: Browser: Zoho Sites contributor invitation with Developer/Admin/Author role. General website-management API not verified.
platforms.required_information: Site URL; installed version; named account/role or owner-assisted session.
platforms.limitations: Zoho CRM tokens, website-member logins and form integrations are not Zoho Sites editor authorization.
